workshop_enter.t: Everything's exactly where he left it. Like he just stepped out to check the wind.
If the workshop's mine now... then so are his questions.

inspect_maps.t: These can't all be right. The same island, drawn in three different places...
'Not an error. It moved.' That's his handwriting.

inspect_sketches.t: Skyfarer fliers. Markings. Brass instruments I've never seen in any shop.
And this... a little white creature with long feathered ears. He drew it over and over, always from far away.

inspect_notes.t: Every strange wind on Brindle Isle, marked and dated. One current circled so many times the paper's worn through.

search_done.t: Wait. The board by the desk. It's always been loose... and the scratches around it are fresh-ish. He's been opening it.

inspect_portrait.t: You always said the sky was a map too. I just never knew how to read it.

inspect_instruments.t: His ancient weather instruments. He never let me touch these.
...He's not here to stop me now. Sorry, Grandpa.

inspect_shelf.t: Atlases, almanacs, a book on Aerian script with half the pages pinned with notes. Grandpa read everything twice.

compartment.t: The board lifts away. Beneath it, a hidden compartment runs the length of the floor.
These brass fittings... nothing in Windrest is made like this. Nothing anywhere is.
Beside it: a pair of antique flight goggles, and a worn leather journal.

final_entry.t: The last page is dated only weeks before Elias died.
The maps are wrong. They always have been.
If you're reading this, look where the wind refuses to go.

compass_awakens.t: Every window's shut. Where is that wind coming from?
On the desk, the brass compass begins to move by itself.
Its needle swings past north, past east, and settles on a direction that isn't on any map.
A wind current... off the edge of the Bluff. That's impossible.
...Look where the wind refuses to go. Okay, Grandpa. First light.

workshop_leave_night.t: Not in the dark. First light.
